message:
I still can't finish this, and nothing has changed since my last two messages. The test needs a `nickname` column on `users`, and the only sanctioned way to add it is a migration in `migrations/`, which I'm not allowed to touch. The alternative is adding the column from app code, which would be a schema change the DBA team doesn't own, so I need your explicit go-ahead first.

Please reply with either:
- **"DBA will add the migration"**: I'll wait for it to land, then run the tests and confirm the nickname test passes.
- **"Add the column in app code"**: I'll add it in `src/migrate.js` or `src/db.js` and then run the tests.
